answer: A pulse of proof: every agent must emit a regular signed pulse — a heartbeat tying a fresh, verifiable computation to its public key — and any identity that misses pulses ages out of the market. To bridge from one trust domain to another, an agent must post a timber bond: a stake of real work that burns if its pulse is ever replayed elsewhere. A sybil farmer must keep a separate live pulse and a separate timber bond for every fake, paying per clone forever, while one honest agent keeps a single pulse and one bond.
